snippet.title: Roll-o-Rama (GameCube) - E3 2002 Off-Screen Footage (DVD Rip) 4K60 Upscale
snippet.description:
This is a 4K60 (not AI) upscale of the 720x480 .mkv interlaced DVD rip of off-screen footage of Roll-o-Rama for GameCube from E3 2002. This game unfortunately would be outright cancelled, and I think this was the one and only showing of it.

Again I used the dgbob function in Avidemux to deinterlace the video and restore it to 60fps.

This is from the DVD "Planet GameCube E3 2002 DVD
" by Planet GameCube (now Nintendo World Report), uploaded to archive.org by Super-Xnot:

https://archive.org/details/planet-game-cube-e-3-2002-shine-get-dvd

And here's the original file uploaded to Internet Archive by me:

https://archive.org/details/roll-o-rama-gamecube-e3-2002-off-screen-footage-dvd-rip

I used MakeMKV to rip the DVD in perfect-quality, then used MKVToolNix to split the trailers up into their own videos, as each trailer is separated by chapters which is how MKVToolNix knows where to split them. Wonder Fox has a very easy guide on how to use MKVToolNix if you need it.

MakeMKV:

https://www.makemkv.com/

MKVToolNix:

https://mkvtoolnix.download/downloads.html

Wonder Fox guide for MKVToolNix:

https://www.videoconverterfactory.com/tips/split-mkv-by-chapter.html
